claim: Exact user-uploaded and SHA-verified original Unity Sprite ClassID213 PathID41553 object b_fc_0000_m_1 contains an original indexed 1,470-byte source span [156,1626), which reads as 735 little-endian uint16 values and exactly 245 consecutive triangle index triples; every index lies in 0..326, all 327 vertex IDs occur, no triple repeats an index and all 245 XY signed triangle cross products are negative. The original 327-entry count at offset1632 and 6,540-byte count at offset1672 identify original contiguous [1676,8216) body span as 327 records of 20 bytes (five float32 values). The first two floats in each record vary within exact byte-derived XY bounds, while the last three float32 words of every record are zero. Source byte digests pin indexed data, descriptor, vertex region and an uninterpreted 52-byte end region, without asserting texture coordinates, a displayed sprite or runtime animation.
